enumerate the challenges and intricacies of adult orthodontics
describe the role of wisdom teeth in orthodontics; and
list and explain the deleterious effects of orthodontic treatment.
courses.content_summary: Management of oral habits. Orthodontic management of cleft patients. Orthodontic management of unerupted canine. Wisdom teeth and their role in orthodontics. Orthodontic management of adult/adolescent patients. Role of orthodontists in management of the orthognathic surgery patient. Deleterious effects of orthodontic treatment.

courses.title: Investigations, Diagnosis and Treatment Planning in Orthodontics
skills_learned: take history and examine an orthodontic patient

describe the different classes of malocclusion; and
explain the basic principles of management of the various classes of malocclusion.

Radiology for orthodontics. Orthodontic treatment plan for angle’s class I, class II division 1, class II division 2, class III. Malocclusions, their features and treatment be able to sequentially and exhaustively take history and examine an orthodontic patient and discuss the rationale for each step.

courses.title: Orthodontic Treatment Options
skills_learned: discuss the physiology of tooth movement
list sequentially and describe the rationale for steps in interceptive orthodontics and serial extraction
list various removable appliances, their components, and describe a few in detail
list various functional appliances, their components, and describe a few in detail
list various modalities of fixed appliance therapy, and describe its components and principles in detail; and

courses.content_summary: Physiology of tooth movement. Interceptive orthodontics. Serial extraction. Removable appliances. Functional appliances. Fixed appliances. Current concepts in orthodontics. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

courses.title: Clinical and Practical Orthodontics
skills_learned: identify the different gauges of wires used in orthodontics and their indications
identify and use different orthodontic instruments to fabricate indicated appliance components; and

courses.content_summary: Materials used in orthodontics, including wires of different gauges. Instruments and consumables used for fabricating appliances. Practical fabrication of appliances and wire bending for appliances including adam’s clasp, labial bow, single cantilever spring, double cantilever spring, C-clasp, and W-wire. Clinical management of patients with various orthodontic complaints including serial extractions, removable appliances. 600 Level

courses.title: Theoretical Basis of Endodontics

courses.content_summary: Treatment planning. Case selection, and prognostication in endodontic therapy, including management of related conditions. Diagnosis and treatment planning in endodontics. Root canal therapy, considerations and rationale, management of traumatic dental injuries management of discoloured teeth.

courses.title: Endodontics

explain the role and methods of radiography in endodontic procedures

appreciate the modifications to treatment when dealing with deciduous and immature permanent teeth.
courses.content_summary: Materials and steps in root canal treatment. The access cavity. Instrumentation. Working length determination. Obturation. Restoration of endodontically treated teeth. Endodontic surgery. Endodontic considerations for deciduous and immature permanent teeth.

courses.title: Theoretical Basis of Advanced Conservation
skills_learned: make diagnosis, risk assessment and management approaches.

provide a cognitive background for the procedures and processes necessary in providing such restorations

skills_learned: demonstrate steps in different restorative and endodontic treatments
conduct case presentations; and
discuss patient management.

Diagnosis of common dental, pulpal and peri-apical conditions. Treatment of common dental, pulpal and peri-apical conditions.

Implant supported complete dentures. Overdentures.

Laboratory stages in partial denture fabrication. Problems with denture classes. Special partial dentures. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

skills_learned: acquire manual skills for prosthodontics; and
improve manual skills for prosthodontics. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

discuss considerations in operating a private and public dental practice, including space, resources, manpower, recent trends
describe the role of quality assurance and improvement in dentistry; and
apply principles of leadership and management to dentistry in private or public settings.

Prevention of oral diseases in the elderly. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

courses.title: Introduction to Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Exodontia in Mature

courses.content_summary: Wound healing, soft and hard tissues. Systemic conditions of importance to the oral and maxillofacial surgeon. Principles and complications of tooth extractions.

Glasgow coma scale, oral and maxillofacial emergencies. Haemorrhage

Atypical infections of the head and neck and their management. Immune suppression and head and neck infections.

Surgical orthodontics.
